I told Dana it's Dock 38, which is what they told me on Oct 14. I got that from their DM history with me, not from the saved memory.

The saved memory didn't work. Looking up Dana's name in the memory store returned nothing. The lookup tool says it only returns "world" facts to remote callers, so the copy I saved as private probably can't be read back by me at all. The world-visible copy is the one I withdrew yesterday. In practice Dana's preference is only kept in the DM history, and yesterday's reply ("Only you can see that note") made the saved note sound more useful than it is. The memory store also flagged this lookup as degraded, so I can't completely rule out a search problem.

Decision for you: do you want member preferences kept in the memory store? If so, saving them as "world" would make them readable again, but then anyone using the store could see what members told me in DMs. I'd rather keep relying on each member's own DM history than do that, unless the memory store can save notes that only the member who gave them can read back.
